'''Jordan Tyler McRae''' (born March 28, 1991) is an American [[college basketball]] player who recently finished his college career for the [[University of Tennessee]]. He is projected to be one of the top selections in the [[2014 NBA Draft]] according to DraftExpress.com.<ref>[http://www.draftexpress.com/profile/Jordan-McRae-5758/ Jordan McRae - DraftExpress]</ref> McRae attended [[Liberty County High School (Fleming, Georgia)|Liberty County High School]] in [[Hinesville, Georgia]],<ref>[http://basketball.realgm.com/player/Jordan-McRae/Summary/9345 Jordan McRae Player Profile, Tennessee Volunteers - RealGM.com]</ref> where he was named a nominee for the [[2010 McDonald's All-American Boys Game]].<ref>[http://www.utsports.com/sports/m-baskbl/mtt/jordan_mcrae_710947.html Jordan McRae Bio - UTSPORTS.COM]</ref> According to [[Rivals.com]], he was the ninth best [[shooting guard (basketball)|shooting guard]] of his class.<ref>[http://sports.yahoo.com/footballrecruiting/basketball/recruiting/player-Jordan-McRae-70399 Jordan McRae - Rivals]</ref>
